serviceName: Certificate for forms on your domain
description: Lets Caramel issue and renew the TLS certificate for a business's forms hostname (step 2 of 2): one delegated certificate-validation CNAME. Apply with host set to the forms hostname's label(s).
variableDescription: dcvlabel: the delegated certificate-validation label for this hostname; the template appends the fixed .dcv.cloudflare.com suffix, so the record can only point into that namespace.
